p.src: 1  Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.

en: Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.
u.src: 1  Woe to those who devise iniquity and work evil on their beds! When the morning is light, they practice it, because it is in the power of their hand.

p.src: 2  They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

en: They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.
u.src: 2  They covet fields and seize them, and houses, then take them away. They oppress a man and his house, even a man and his heritage.

p.src: 3  Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.

en: Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.
u.src: 3  Therefore the LORD says: “Behold, I am planning against these people a disaster, from which you will not remove your necks, neither will you walk haughtily, for it is an evil time.

p.src: 4  In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”

en: In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”
u.src: 4  In that day they will take up a parable against you, and lament with a doleful lamentation, saying, ‘We are utterly ruined! My people’s possession is divided up. Indeed he takes it from me and assigns our fields to traitors!’”

p.src: 5  Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD’s assembly.

en: Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD’s assembly.
u.src: 5  Therefore you will have no one who divides the land by lot in the LORD’s assembly.

p.src: 6  “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”

en: “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”
u.src: 6  “Don’t prophesy!”—they prophesy— “Don’t prophesy about these things. Disgrace won’t overtake us.”

p.src: 7  Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the LORD’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”

en: Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the LORD’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”
u.src: 7  Shall it be said, O house of Jacob, “Is the LORD’s Spirit angry? Are these his doings? Don’t my words do good to him who walks blamelessly?”

p.src: 8  But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.

en: But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.
u.src: 8  But lately my people have risen up as an enemy. You strip the robe and clothing from those who pass by without a care, returning from battle.

p.src: 9  You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.

en: You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.
u.src: 9  You drive the women of my people out from their pleasant houses; from their young children you take away my blessing forever.

p.src: 10  Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.

en: Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.
u.src: 10  Arise, and depart! For this is not your resting place, because of uncleanness that destroys, even with a grievous destruction.

p.src: 11  If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.

en: If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.
u.src: 11  If a man walking in a spirit of falsehood lies, saying, “I will prophesy to you of wine and of strong drink,” he would be the prophet of this people.

p.src: 12  I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.

en: I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.
u.src: 12  I will surely assemble all of you, Jacob. I will surely gather the remnant of Israel. I will put them together as the sheep of Bozrah, as a flock in the middle of their pasture. They will swarm with people.

p.src: 13  He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with the LORD at their head.

en: He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with the LORD at their head.
u.src: 13  He who breaks open the way goes up before them. They break through the gate, and go out. Their king passes on before them, with the LORD at their head.
